title: Stylized Red Eye on Black Background
coreRelationships: The red eye is the sole focal point against the stark black background.
Concentric circles form the pupil, drawing attention to the center of the eye.
Blocky, irregular 'eyelashes' frame the eye, adding to its stylized nature.
The vibrant red contrasts sharply with the deep black, creating a high-impact visual.
